settings.layer1_body:
Radiant Life™ operates as a structured longitudinal documentation system.

We collect only the information required to operate the Assessment, the RL100 Tracking System, and related governance functions. Data is handled with restraint, purpose limitation, and respect for participant autonomy.

We do not sell personal data.

We do not monetize biological inputs.

We do not use assessment or tracking data for advertising optimization.

Information is collected to preserve measurement integrity, apply eligibility determination within structured protocol rules, and support longitudinal interpretability across defined documentation windows.

Research participation, where offered, is separate from core system participation and does not alter protocol access. Participation in anonymized research analysis is separately consented and never incentivized.

settings.title: What Data Is Collected
settings.body:
Basic identity and account information. Assessment responses. RL100 tracking inputs at defined measurement points. Structured photo anchors. System usage events required for integrity enforcement.

No continuous monitoring. No background surveillance. No passive biometric tracking.

settings.title: How Biological Data Is Used
settings.body:
Biological inputs are used exclusively to: Establish standardized baselines. Compare response across time. Apply eligibility logic. Preserve interpretive consistency.

They are never used to predict outcomes, rank participants, or create behavioral targeting profiles.

settings.title: Research Dataset Separation
settings.body:
Where research consent is provided: Identifiable data (Tier A) is separated from de-identified dataset (Tier B). De-identification occurs prior to analysis. Aggregate reporting occurs at cohort level only.

Research participation is voluntary and does not alter system access.

settings.title: Data Retention & Continuity
settings.body: Longitudinal documentation requires continuity. Certain data is retained to preserve interpretability across each 100-day window. Deletion requests are honored where legally required and operationally feasible, with the understanding that removal may invalidate longitudinal comparison.
